anchor_prompt: Handheld UGC-style vertical smartphone photo inside a bright modern home kitchen in soft morning daylight, a yoga mat rolled out on the floor beside the kitchen island. A fit woman in her early 30s with dark shoulder-length hair, wearing a sage green sports bra and matching leggings, stands at the island holding her phone and smiling toward the camera. Natural window light, realistic skin textures, candid unedited smartphone look.

vars.setting: a bright modern home kitchen in soft morning daylight with a yoga mat rolled out beside the kitchen island
vars.cast_description: The fit woman in her early 30s with dark shoulder-length hair, wearing a sage green sports bra and matching leggings, stands in the same kitchen.
vars.scene_1: She looks straight into the vertical smartphone camera and says brightly, 'I used to skip my workouts every single week.' She steps onto the yoga mat and starts a short bodyweight squat set, then glances back at the camera and adds, 'Until I made it a fifteen-minute morning habit.'
vars.scene_2: She finishes the set, picks up her phone from the island, shows the screen to the camera and says, 'Daygo.fit plans my session every morning, so I just show up.' She smiles and says, 'Start your routine with Daygo.fit today.'
